items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: Les called me and said, “Let’s go to the bar.” ... “Hal, I need a first trumpet player ... I’d like you to be my first chair player ... So I was ecstatic. I said, “You’ve got me Les, I’m ready.”

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know who you mean.

He goes way back. But I think he fooled around with the clarinet. And it’s been so long ago I don’t remember now. But anyway I worked for him. And then a movie came into town and I got to do some sidelining on a movie and I thought you know this is really a great way to make money. And I was making money then as a kid playing in these jobs. And I’d do a few casuals while I was in college. So only then did I start thinking I wonder if I could ever be good enough to play professionally. Because in high school I’d…
Was the concept of — were you aware of the concept of what they called the “jazz chair” in the big bands at that point?
